bio: Angela Nixon (born February 27, 1984) is an American politician and businesswoman who has served as a member of the Florida House of Representatives since 2020. A member of the Working Families Party and the Democratic Socialists of America, she was the Democratic nominee in the 2026 United States Senate special election in Florida, losing to Republican incumbent Ashley Moody.
